html:
G'oya

Menejer ham, bosh menejer ham employees dagi xodim. Jadvalni uch marta ishlatamiz: e xodim, m uning menejeri, mm menejerning menejeri. Ikkinchi ulanish xodimga emas, m ga bog'lanadi.

Yechim

SELECT e.name AS employee, m.name AS manager, mm.name AS senior_manager
FROM employees e
LEFT JOIN employees m ON m.id = e.manager_id
LEFT JOIN employees mm ON mm.id = m.manager_id

Ikkala ulanish ham LEFT JOIN, chunki zanjir istalgan joyda uzilishi mumkin. Namunada Aziz eng yuqori rahbar, uning ikkala ustuni NULL. Boburning menejeri Aziz, bosh menejeri yo'q. Eldorda zanjir to'liq: menejeri Dilshod, bosh menejeri Bobur.

Tuzoqlar

Birinchisini LEFT, ikkinchisini oddiy JOIN qilish. Bosh menejeri yo'q har bir xodim yo'qoladi: namunadagi beshtadan faqat Dilshod va Eldor qoladi.

Noto'g'riSELECT e.name AS employee, m.name AS manager, mm.name AS senior_manager
FROM employees e
LEFT JOIN employees m ON m.id = e.manager_id
JOIN employees mm ON mm.id = m.manager_id

Zanjirda bir marta LEFT JOIN boshlansa, davomi ham odatda LEFT bo'lishi kerak.

Yana bir xato: ikkinchi ulanishni ham e.manager_id ga bog'lash. Unda mm menejerning o'zi bo'lib chiqadi. Bosh menejer m.manager_id orqali topiladi.
